messages:
zoe (marketing): quick heads-up: ran a 1.2k leads/min spike against the new webinar form. saw ~7% fallback to default owner and a few missed enrichment fields. notes in drive.

raj (ops): 7% is high. what was enrichment timeout in consumer?

zoe (marketing): test used 1s to match vendor SLA. prod is 1.4s.

mike (growth): any correlation with round-robin churn? i.e., owners being reassigned causing duplicates?

ella (sales-ops): looked at SF logs: duplicate leads happened when claim retried after initial fallback. fallback assigns default owner, then enrichment returns and claim retries -> creates duplicate.

raj (ops): code pattern to blame: 
```
if (enrichment.done || now - start > TTL) assignDefault()
else wait()
```
We should avoid immediate default assign if enrichment pending and queue_depth high. route to warm-standby instead.

zoe (marketing): proposal: add campaign flag high_volume=true for webinars, soft-hold 300ms when queue_depth > 30, warm-pool owner inbound-warm. also increase timeout to 1.5s during campaign windows.

mike (growth): +1. will enable flag on upcoming webinar templates.

ella (sales-ops): I'll add SF rule: WHEN campaign.metadata.high_volume = true THEN owner = inbound-warm. also add dedupe step on enrichment callback to avoid duplicates.

raj (ops): action items: PR to add soft-hold + queue_depth metric, feature flag to enable warm-pool routing, and a canary deploy.

deploy-bot: deploy queued by raj: tag inbound-warm-2026-03-23. rollout: 10% -> 100% with 10m canary.

zoe (marketing): add runbook step: if fallthrough > 2% during event -> enable warm-pool + bump timeout. i'll put graphs in runbook.

raj (ops): will open PR today and post link.
